about: The four fixes from the 2026-11-12 backlog film, filmed again (engine branch off context-content): the S.S. Same stops and bursts as backlog_2026-11-12's 1 and 2, so the frames compare index for index; the PLANT's burst runs longer for the cave card's flash. Watch held at day, clear weather, follower away; the theatre's debug scratch save; nothing is saved.
